# Deployment checklist for teleport.corp.example

Generated by the tangra deployment wizard for Teleport 18.7.0.

## Host

- [ ] A Linux host with systemd, at least 2 vCPU and 1 GB of memory (4 GB
      for more than a few dozen users or resources), and `curl` installed.
- [ ] Outbound HTTPS to cdn.teleport.dev (the installer).

## DNS

- [ ] An A (or AAAA) record for `teleport.corp.example` pointing to the host's public address.
- [ ] An A (or AAAA) record for `*.teleport.corp.example` pointing to the same address (application access).

## Network

- [ ] TCP port 443 open to all sources: the web UI, `tsh` and agents all use it.
- [ ] Nothing else listening on port 443 on the host.

## Certificate

- [ ] A certificate valid for `teleport.corp.example` and `*.teleport.corp.example`, with its full
      chain in `/etc/teleport/tls/fullchain.pem` and its key in
      `/etc/teleport/tls/privkey.pem` (mode 0600, owned by root).

## Then

1. Run `install.sh` as root next to `teleport.yaml`.
2. Follow `setup-commands.txt`: the first administrator, then the
   `tangra-manager` role and the management identity.
3. Run the wizard's prerequisite checks, then register the cluster.
